name: Berries ‘n Cream Pie
subtitle: From Jeff’s Aunt Sarah
time: ~5 hr 15 min, ~15 min hands-on (mostly chilling; estimated)
notes: This recipe came from Jeff’s Aunt Sarah—it’s super tasty and super easy!

steps.title: Add the berries
steps.body: Pour **3 cups boysenberries or blackberries** into the unbaked pie crust.

steps.title: Make the custard
steps.body: In a mixing bowl, whisk together **⅔ cup sugar**, **¼ cup flour** and **1 tsp cinnamon** with **1 cup heavy whipping cream**.

steps.title: Pour and bake
steps.body: Pour mixture over the berries, and then bake the pie for about one hour, covering the edges of the crust with foil about halfway through the baking time to keep the crust from over-browning.

steps.title: Check for doneness
steps.body: You can tell your pie is done when the edges have slightly puffed and the center slightly wobbles when you move the pie.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.body: Remove the pie to a wire rack to cool completely. Then refrigerate and allow the pie to chill completely before serving.
